transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
The UK will evaluate artificial intelligence models before their release, reversing US policy that required White House approval. Reported by NDTV Profit.
Microsoft president Brad Smith urges the UK to lead global artificial intelligence safety efforts amid US pushback and calls for stronger oversight. Confirmed by TechCrunch.
Nvidia still leads in artificial intelligence infrastructure, and investment should focus on big tech and semiconductors. Reported by 뉴시스.
Microsoft's Maia 300 boosts artificial intelligence inference with 40% efficiency gain and 7x token throughput. Reported by Tech Edition.
L&T Technology Services opens an artificial intelligence native EI Lab in Bengaluru for digital manufacturing experiences. Reported by ELE Times.
